# Second Brain + Multi-Agent Architecture (Handoff Map)

This is a single-page map of everything built across Rounds 1–5 plus the
finish-up round. It exists so a future you (or anyone picking this up
cold) can understand what's here and where it lives.

**Last update:** 2026-05-29

---

## 1. The Two Brains

JARVIS operates with two distinct knowledge systems. They are intentionally
separated.

### 1a. Project Brain (read-mostly)
**Location:** `~/Desktop/graphify-out/obsidian/_Memory/`
**Code:** `memory/wiki.py`
**Contents:** Technical/codebase notes generated by graphify
**Curator:** Not JARVIS. Read-only from JARVIS's perspective.
**Used by:** `_build_context()` in `brain/think.py` when the query has business signals

### 1b. Personal Second Brain (write-active)
**Location:** `~/Documents/SecondBrain/`
**Code:** `memory/vault.py` (VaultManager), `memory/observations.py` (staging)
**Contents:** Elnatan's life — interests, decisions, relationships, goals,
patterns
**Curator:** Elnatan owns it. JARVIS is the only agent with write access.

**Vault layout:**
```
~/Documents/SecondBrain/
├── _JARVIS/
│   ├── _Activity.md          ← human-readable audit log
│   ├── _Activity.jsonl       ← machine-readable audit log
│   ├── _PersonalModel.md     ← always proposal-only
│   └── Proposals/
│       └── YYYY-MM-DD-NNN.md ← one file per pending change
├── Personal/        [medium risk]
├── Business/        [HIGH risk — propose only]
├── Learning/        [low risk — auto-write]
├── Relationships/   [HIGH risk — propose only]
├── Goals/           [medium risk]
├── Decisions/       [HIGH risk — propose only]
├── Daily/           [low risk — auto-write]
└── Archive/         [low risk]
```

## 2. The Multi-Agent Cast

| Agent | Backend | Persona file | Tool access |
|---|---|---|---|
| JARVIS  | Claude Sonnet/Opus/Haiku | `prompts/personas/jarvis.md`   | Full registry — only agent with vault write access |
| FRIDAY  | Gemini 2.0 Flash         | `prompts/personas/friday.md`   | Read-only via auto-injected brain context |
| VERONICA| Groq Llama-3.3-70b       | `prompts/personas/veronica.md` | Read-only via auto-injected brain context |
| KAREN   | Mistral Medium           | `prompts/personas/karen.md`    | Read-only via auto-injected brain context |

**Inter-agent communication model (current implementation):**
- `[KAREN]` / `[VERONICA]` inline voice tags in JARVIS's response are simulated
  — JARVIS role-plays those voices when their perspective adds value. Real
  multi-agent calling (B3) is deferred.
- `[BRAIN: suggest → ...]` from non-JARVIS agents nudges JARVIS without
  invoking a vault tool. JARVIS decides whether to act.
- Non-JARVIS agents receive brain context via `_get_brain_context_for_agent`
  in `brain/free_agents.py` (signal-triggered auto-injection).

---

## 3. The Tool Layer

**Registry:** `brain/tools/registry.py`
- `tool(description, parameters, allowed_agents=None)` decorator
- `get_tools(agent=None)` returns schemas filtered by allowed agent
- `execute_tool(name, args, agent=None)` refuses calls from disallowed agents

**Second Brain tools** (`brain/tools/second_brain.py`):

| Tool | Access |
|---|---|
| `search_brain`, `get_brain_note`, `list_brain_notes`, `review_proposals` | All agents |
| `create_brain_note`, `update_brain_note`, `propose_brain_change`, `approve_proposal`, `reject_proposal`, `update_personal_model` | `allowed_agents=["JARVIS"]` only |

The non-JARVIS agents don't currently invoke any tools at runtime (their API
call paths don't include tool channels), but if/when they do, the registry
enforces write restrictions at code level — not just in prompts.

---

## 4. Visibility & Notification Pipeline

When any agent message reaches the server, this pipeline runs:

```
agent text
   ↓
brain/visibility.py: classify(text, agent, source) → {visibility, tags}
   ↓
   ├──→ SSE done event includes {visibility, tags}
   ├──→ /api/proactive items include {visibility, tags}
   └──→ brain/notify.py: maybe_telegram_brain_alert()
            (silent unless TELEGRAM_BRAIN_ALERTS=1 env var)
            (fires only on surface + BRAIN action)
```

**Three visibility levels:**

| Level | Triggers |
|---|---|
| `surface`   | `[BRAIN:]` action tag, `[SENSITIVE]`, Tier 3 destructive actions, `_PersonalModel` references, observer `[OBS]` insights |
| `normal`    | Default — standard conversation |
| `collapsed` | Non-JARVIS `[BRAIN: suggest →]`, agent-deferral phrases ("that's JARVIS territory"), one-word acks |

---

## 5. The HUD (Group Chat Rendering)

**File:** `app/hud.html`

**B5 — Group chat rendering:**
- `parseVoiceBlocks(text)` splits messages on `[JARVIS]/[FRIDAY]/[VERONICA]/[KAREN]` markers
- `extractBrainChips(text)` pulls `[BRAIN: ...]` / `[SENSITIVE]` tags into colored chips
- `renderRichMessage()` builds the full message with voice pills + chips
- `renderCollapsedMessage()` shows a muted single-line preview that expands on click

**B7 — Notification badge:**
- `⬡ N NEW` chip in chat-header
- Fires only on `surface` + BRAIN action + user idle (30s + not at bottom of chat)
- localStorage persistence with 24h auto-clear, cross-tab sync via `storage` event

**Image rendering ([SHOW:]):**
- A7 default-to-showing rule in `prompts/personas/jarvis.md`
- A8 Second Brain enrichment — when JARVIS surfaces brain content
  that includes a visual subject, [SHOW:] is added to ground the
  retrieval visually

---

## 6. The Observer (B8 Grounded)

**File:** `brain/observer.py`

Runs every 6 minutes. Caps: 3 pushes per hour, 5-minute cooldown between
pushes, respects `observer_quiet` meta flag.

**Loop:**
1. `_detect_pattern()` — scans last 80 messages for recurring topics (≥5 hits)
2. **B8 grounding:** `_search_brain_for_topic(topic)` queries the vault
3. If brain content found → `VAULT CONTEXT` block is appended to the LLM input
4. `_generate_insight()` — Haiku writes the surfaced observation. Grounding
   rule in the prompt: if vault context is present, MUST reference it; if
   absent, restricted to pattern-only commentary
5. Grounded insights get `[BRAIN: GROUNDED]` appended → green grounding
   chip in HUD via B5

**Re-enabled in Round 1** (`ui/server.py` `__main__` block). The proactive
scheduler stays off — only the observer is active.

---

## 7. The Prompt Loader

**File:** `prompts/runtime/prompt_loader.py`

`compose_full_system_prompt(agent, include_static_context, include_business,
include_security)` builds the system prompt.

**Key behavior:**
- `include_business=False` for JARVIS by default — business context (Addis
  Market, KPIs) is no longer in the static prompt
- `_build_context(user_input)` in `brain/think.py` injects business context
  dynamically only when `_is_business_query(user_input)` returns True
- `load_second_brain_modules()` loads the consolidated `second_brain.md`
  (Round 3 — merged three modules into one)

**Current JARVIS_SYSTEM size:** ~42k chars

---

## 8. Observation Staging (Future-ready)

**File:** `memory/observations.py`

SQLite table buffering raw life signals before synthesis. Today the only
producer is `memory/wiki.py learn()` which routes personal-fact-categories
to observations (technical facts still go to graphify).

**Quality filter:** 4 criteria — length floor, signal words, personal anchors,
source credibility. Failing observations are stored with `quality=0` and
never reach synthesis.

**Deduplication:** content-hash within 24h skips identical observations.
**Suppression:** `suppress_topic("Addis Market")` retroactively marks
matching pending observations as quality=0.

**What's missing:** The background synthesis worker (B9) that drains
`get_pending_observations()` and turns them into vault notes. This is
the next major sub-project.

---

## 9. Per-Agent Brain Context (Finish-up Round)

**File:** `brain/free_agents.py` `_get_brain_context_for_agent(query)`

When FRIDAY/VERONICA/KAREN are invoked with a personal-signal query, the
helper:
1. Reuses the singleton `VaultManager` from `brain/think.py`
2. Runs `search_vault(query, max_results=2)`
3. Returns the result wrapped in a `BRAIN CONTEXT (auto-injected)` block

The block is concatenated into the existing `wiki` slot passed to each
agent's system prompt builder. No tool calling required — the agents
just read it.

---

## 9b. Ingestion Layer (Personal Information Loading)

Three paths to get personal content into the vault:

### Manual intake (interactive)
**Script:** `scripts/personal_intake.py`

Run once to seed the Personal Model + core vault notes. Walks through
6 Personal Model sections (Interests, Energy Patterns, Decision-Making
Style, Communication Preferences, Known Challenges, Relationship
Patterns) plus 6 core areas (Goals, Daily Rhythm, Reading, Inner
Circle, Active Ventures, Open Decisions). Everything you answer gets
staged as proposals you review.

Re-runnable safely. Empty input skips the question.

### Email ingestion (manual trigger)
**Tool:** `ingest_recent_emails(count)` — JARVIS-only

Reads recent IMAP inbox via the existing `control/email.py` helper.
Filters:
- Hardcoded skip list (no-reply, newsletter, notifications, mailer-daemon)
- Subject-line skip (receipts, invoices, password resets)
- Optional allowlist via `EMAIL_INGEST_ALLOWLIST` env var

Survivors are classified into a Second Brain area (Relationships,
Business, Decisions, Personal, Daily) and assigned sensitivity (low/
medium/high). Each becomes an observation in the staging layer (same
quality filter as conversation-source observations). JARVIS surfaces
them via `review_proposals` once synthesis runs.

Not scheduled — invoke explicitly: "JARVIS, ingest recent emails."

### Claude chat synthesis
**Tool:** `synthesize_claude_chat(transcript_path, session_label)` — JARVIS-only

Reads a transcript file (.md, .txt, or .json — Claude.ai JSON export
format supported) and asks Haiku to extract structured insights:
decisions, patterns, interests, goals, people, preferences. Each
insight is staged as a Second Brain proposal with evidence.

**The raw transcript is never copied into the vault** — only the
distilled insights. This avoids the noise/dilution problem of dumping
transcripts directly.

Invoke explicitly: "JARVIS, synthesize the chat at ~/Desktop/chat.md."

### Phase 2 — On Hold (do not implement, prototype, or plan)

The full holographic spatial interface described in
`docs/ui/hud-multi-agent-design-spec.md` is intentionally parked.
That document is referenced **for aesthetic language and MCU color vocabulary only** — never as a Phase 1 implementation target.

Items that are explicitly Phase 2:

| Item | Why deferred |
|---|---|
| **Home Zone bubble** — floating corner cluster that holds all four agents | Requires WebGL/Metal orb renderer; fundamentally different UI architecture |
| **Agent orbs** — individual holographic spheres per agent | Same WebGL/Metal requirement; 7-layer material + personality noise |
| **Cloud expansion animation** — orbs travel from bubble into a content cloud | Spatial travel system, no DOM equivalent |
| **4-corner layout** — agents at fixed corner positions (VERONICA TL, JARVIS TR, KAREN BL, FRIDAY BR) | Replaces current chat-centric layout entirely |
| **"Really Active" states** — agent orb scales/pulses to 1.9–2.15× when flagged priority | Part of the orb rendering system |
| **Spatial travel** — agents moving between positions with personality-driven arcs | WebGL animation system |
| **Content windows + sovereignty rules** — agent-owned content panels, priority arbitration | Full window management system |
| **Session start ritual** — 0–14.5s materialization sequence, JARVIS greeting, team settle | Cinematic sequencer |

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | JARVIS (and Haiku fallbacks) |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | FRIDAY primary |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | VERONICA primary + several fallbacks |
| `MISTRAL_API_KEY` | KAREN primary |
| `XAI_API_KEY` | JARVIS Grok fallback |
| `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` | Telegram delivery channel |
| `TELEGRAM_BRAIN_ALERTS=1` | **Opt-in** for Second Brain cross-device alerts |
| `JARVIS_LOCATION`, `JARVIS_TIMEZONE` | Location/time context injection |

## 14. Where To Look When Things Go Wrong

| Symptom | First place to look |
|---|---|
| JARVIS not using brain tools | `prompts/personas/jarvis.md` Second Brain section + `load_second_brain_modules()` |
| FRIDAY/VERONICA/KAREN can't see brain content | `_get_brain_context_for_agent` signal set in `brain/free_agents.py` |
| Brain writes going to wrong vault | `memory/wiki.py` `_PERSONAL_NOTE_TOPICS` classifier |
| HUD not showing chips | `app/hud.html` — `extractBrainChips`, `brainChipClass` |
| Badge not firing | `app/hud.html` — `maybeBumpBrainBadge` (visibility + tags + idle requirements) |
| Telegram alerts not arriving | Check `TELEGRAM_BRAIN_ALERTS=1` env var is set; check `brain/notify.py` filter |
| Observer surfacing repetitive insights | `brain/observer.py` — check vault has content for the topic; B8 grounding requires it |
| Prompt too large | `brain/think.py` `_build_jarvis_system()` — verify `include_business=False`; check `prompts/specialized/second_brain.md` not the old three modules |

## 15. Phase 1 Completion Notes

**Completed 2026-05-29.** Phase 1 (B5/B6/B7) is fully shipped. Summary of what was done in the final hardening pass:

**Observer classified push (new):**
`brain/observer.py` `_push()` now emits `{text, visibility, tags}` dicts instead of plain strings. The insight is classified via `brain.visibility.classify()` before being placed on the queue. The server's `proactive_poll` retains full backward compatibility with legacy plain-string producers (normalizes both at the drain site in `ui/server.py`).

**Color consistency (fixed):**
Three agents had wrong colors across implementations. All four canonical colors are now consistent across `app/hud.html` (CSS variables + JS `AGENT_COLORS`), `JARVISApp/JARVIS/HUDRingView.swift`, and `docs/AGENTS.md`:
- FRIDAY was purple in `HUDRingView.swift` — fixed to orange `#FF6A00`
- VERONICA was purple in `hud.html` — fixed to mint `#00FF9F`
- KAREN was purple in `hud.html` — fixed to amber `#FFB450`
- JARVIS aligned to `#00E5FF` in both Swift and web

**Tests added:**
`tests/test_observer_push.py` — covers the observer push path: dict structure, correct visibility/tags, [OBS] prefix, OBSERVER tag extraction, and the grounding tag path.

**Known minor items (not blocking):**
- B3 real multi-agent pipeline (actual Gemini/Groq tool calls) remains deferred — see section 11.
- B9 background synthesis worker remains deferred — see section 11.
- Agent panel mini-bars in the HUD are driven by static random values; no live backend signal is wired. This is cosmetic and Phase 2 adjacent.
